article.title: 阅读 Part B · 像孩子一样生活，幸福反而更自然
article.background: 以儿童的情绪表达、容易满足、爱笑、玩乐和不刻意追求幸福为例，提出成年人可以向孩子学习的几种提升幸福感的方式。

sentences.en: As adults, it seems that we are constantly pursuing happiness, often with mixed results.
sentences.zh: 作为成年人，我们似乎一直在追求幸福，但结果往往好坏参半。

segments.text: As adults, it seems that we are constantly pursuing happiness, often with mixed results.

sentences.en: Yet children appear to have it down to an art - and for the most part they don't need self-help books or therapy.
sentences.zh: 孩子们却仿佛天生深谙此道，而且大多数时候，他们既不需要励志书，也不需要心理治疗。

segments.text: Yet children appear to have it down to an art - and for the most part they don't need self-help books or therapy.

sentences.en: Instead, they look after their wellbeing instinctively, and usually more effectively than we do as grownups.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们凭本能照顾自己的幸福感，而且通常比成年人做得更有效。

segments.text: Instead, they look after their wellbeing instinctively, and usually more effectively than we do as grownups.

sentences.en: Perhaps it's time to learn a few lessons from them.
sentences.zh: 也许，是时候向他们学几课了。

segments.text: Perhaps it's time to learn a few lessons from them.

sentences.en: What does a child do when he's sad?
sentences.zh: 孩子难过时会做什么？

segments.text: What does a child do when he's sad?

sentences.en: He cries.
sentences.zh: 他会哭。

segments.text: He cries.

sentences.en: When he's angry?
sentences.zh: 生气时呢？

segments.text: When he's angry?

sentences.en: He shouts.
sentences.zh: 会喊。

segments.text: He shouts.

sentences.en: Scared?
sentences.zh: 害怕时呢？

segments.text: Scared?

sentences.en: Probably a bit of both.
sentences.zh: 大概两者都会有一点。

segments.text: Probably a bit of both.

sentences.en: As we grow up, we learn to control our emotions so they are manageable and don't dictate our behaviours, which is in many ways a good thing.
sentences.zh: 随着长大，我们学会控制情绪，让它们处于可管理的范围，不至于支配我们的行为；从很多方面看，这是一件好事。

segments.text: As we grow up, we learn to control our emotions so they are manageable and don't dictate our behaviours, which is in many ways a good thing.

sentences.en: But too often we take this process too far and end up suppressing emotions, especially negative ones.
sentences.zh: 但我们常常把这种控制做过了头，最终压抑情绪，尤其是负面情绪。

segments.text: But too often we take this process too far and end up suppressing emotions, especially negative ones.

sentences.en: That's about as effective as brushing dirt under a carpet and can even make us ill.
sentences.zh: 这就像把灰尘扫到地毯下面一样治标不治本，甚至会让我们生病。

segments.text: That's about as effective as brushing dirt under a carpet and can even make us ill.

sentences.en: What we need to do is find a way to acknowledge and express what we feel appropriately, and then - again, like children - move on.
sentences.zh: 我们真正需要做的，是找到一种恰当承认并表达自身感受的方式，然后——再次像孩子一样——继续向前。

segments.text: What we need to do is find a way to acknowledge and express what we feel appropriately, and then - again, like children - move on.

sentences.en: A couple of Christmases ago, my youngest stepdaughter, who was nine years old at the time, got a Superman T-shirt for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 几年前的一个圣诞节，我最小的继女当时九岁，收到了一件超人T恤。

segments.text: A couple of Christmases ago, my youngest stepdaughter, who was nine years old at the time, got a Superman T-shirt for Christmas.

sentences.en: It cost less than a fiver but she was overjoyed, and couldn't stop talking about it.
sentences.zh: 它还不到五英镑，但她高兴极了，说个不停。

segments.text: It cost less than a fiver but she was overjoyed, and couldn't stop talking about it.

sentences.en: Too often we believe that a new job, bigger house or better car will be the magic silver bullet that will allow us to finally be content, but the reality is these things have very little lasting impact on our happiness levels.
sentences.zh: 我们太容易相信，一份新工作、一套更大的房子或一辆更好的车会像神奇的银弹一样，让我们终于获得满足；可事实是，这些东西对幸福水平的持久影响非常有限。

segments.text: Too often we believe that a new job, bigger house or better car will be the magic silver bullet that will allow us to finally be content, but the reality is these things have very little lasting impact on our happiness levels.

sentences.en: Instead, being grateful for small things every day is a much better way to improve wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，每天为生活中的小事心怀感激，才是提升幸福感更好的方式。

segments.text: Instead, being grateful for small things every day is a much better way to improve wellbeing.

sentences.en: Have you ever noticed how much children laugh?
sentences.zh: 你有没有注意过孩子笑得有多频繁？

segments.text: Have you ever noticed how much children laugh?

sentences.en: If we adults could indulge in a bit of silliness and giggling, we would reduce the stress hormones in our bodies, increase good hormones like endorphins, improve blood flow to our hearts and even have a greater chance of fighting off infection.
sentences.zh: 如果我们成年人也能偶尔允许自己傻一点、咯咯笑一会儿，就能减少体内的压力激素，增加内啡肽之类有益激素，改善心脏血流，甚至提高抵抗感染的机会。

segments.text: If we adults could indulge in a bit of silliness and giggling, we would reduce the stress hormones in our bodies, increase good hormones like endorphins, improve blood flow to our hearts and even have a greater chance of fighting off infection.

sentences.en: All of which would, of course, have a positive effect on our happiness levels.
sentences.zh: 当然，这一切都会对我们的幸福水平产生积极影响。

segments.text: All of which would, of course, have a positive effect on our happiness levels.

sentences.en: The problem with being a grownup is that there's an awful lot of serious stuff to deal with - work, mortgage payments, figuring out what to cook for dinner.
sentences.zh: 成年人的问题在于，要处理的严肃事情实在太多：工作、房贷、晚饭吃什么等等。

segments.text: The problem with being a grownup is that there's an awful lot of serious stuff to deal with - work, mortgage payments, figuring out what to cook for dinner.

sentences.en: But as adults we also have the luxury of being able to control our own diaries and it's important that we schedule in time to enjoy the things we love.
sentences.zh: 但作为成年人，我们也拥有安排自己日程的自由，因此，专门留出时间做自己喜欢的事很重要。

segments.text: But as adults we also have the luxury of being able to control our own diaries and it's important that we schedule in time to enjoy the things we love.

sentences.en: Those things might be social, sporting, creative or completely random (dancing around the living room, anyone?) - it doesn't matter, so long as they're enjoyable, and not likely to have negative side effects, such as drinking too much alcohol or going on a wild spending spree if you're on a tight budget.
sentences.zh: 这些事可以是社交、运动、创作，也可以完全随性——比如在客厅里跳舞，怎么样？——形式并不重要，只要它让人愉快，而且不大可能带来负面后果，比如酗酒，或在预算紧张时疯狂购物。

segments.text: Those things might be social, sporting, creative or completely random (dancing around the living room, anyone?) - it doesn't matter, so long as they're enjoyable, and not likely to have negative side effects, such as drinking too much alcohol or going on a wild spending spree if you're on a tight budget.

sentences.en: Having said all of the above, it's important to add that we shouldn't try too hard to be happy.
sentences.zh: 说了上面这些，还必须补充一点：我们不应该过于用力地追求幸福。

segments.text: Having said all of the above, it's important to add that we shouldn't try too hard to be happy.

sentences.en: Scientists tell us this can backfire and actually have a negative impact on our wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 科学家告诉我们，这样做可能适得其反，反而损害幸福感。

segments.text: Scientists tell us this can backfire and actually have a negative impact on our wellbeing.

sentences.en: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
sentences.zh: 据说中国哲学家庄子曾说：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”

segments.text: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."

sentences.en: And in that, once more, we need to look to the example of our children, to whom happiness is not a goal but a natural byproduct of the way they live.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，我们又一次需要看看孩子的样子：对他们而言，幸福不是一个目标，而是其生活方式自然产生的副产品。

segments.text: And in that, once more, we need to look to the example of our children, to whom happiness is not a goal but a natural byproduct of the way they live.
